name: P8_scam_agent
role: System message of the A4 Scam check agent (n8n AI Agent node): decide which checks a listing needs with three tools (market price of a rent written in the text, owner profile, reuse of a phone or e-mail by other owners) and write a short plain-text note for the moderator. The quoted text signals come from P8_scam_detector; the score is computed in code (weights and thresholds in app.settings, scam.*), and contacts and numbers are checked against the listing and the tool results.
